event_identity_evidence.interpretation: The excluded v11 smoke retained 16 official games and 16 provider events: 15 exact-team mappings differed by +60 seconds and one by 0 seconds. The 60-second value is an outcome-blind fail-closed identity-consistency bound for a new incompatible smoke, not a betting threshold and not a nearest-event selector.

interpretation: These are locked operational safety windows for an unattended collector, not fitted betting thresholds. Predictions are prepared up to 20 minutes before T-4h so network-bound feature generation can finish; provider capture may begin no earlier than 120 seconds before T-4h and must finish by T-4h. Exact normalized team pairs and equal-cardinality chronological mapping establish event identity; the measured start-delta bound can only reject a mapping, never choose one. Any miss or ambiguity remains a failure and is never backfilled.
required_review: Measure prediction and provider runtime distributions during the shadow period
Any event start delta above the bound or any unequal/ambiguous team-pair cardinality hard-fails
Do not change these values during an evidence window without creating a new hashed runtime version
Never use operational timing changes to tune performance after outcomes are known
